title: Polyiamond Placement: triangle-tiled territory game
description: Blokus variant played on a triangular grid. Players place polyiamond pieces (shapes made of equilateral triangles) onto the board. Pieces must touch your own pieces at corners only (not edges). Validates: triangular grid topology (not hex, not square — equilateral triangle tiling), polyiamond piece shapes (multi-cell spans on triangular grid), corner-only adjacency constraint. Requires a new zone_type for triangular grids, or modeling as a graph.
close_reason: Polyiamond Placement fully playable. 486-cell hex board, triangular grid with D6 symmetry, 22 algorithmically generated polyiamond pieces, corner-only adjacency, 2/4 players. 50 tests.
